messages:
ana: Quick design sync 19 on the rollout timeline inspector. Uploaded a compact frame to Figma. Main trade: transient hover preview vs explicit open for keyboard/touch.

mike: Hover preview is nice for mouse. Need parity for keyboard and screen readers.

sam: Tech approach: CSS hover preview + JS-controlled persistent inspector on Enter/click. Use aria-expanded on the node.

yvonne: Accessibility: no hover-only tooltips. Add aria-describedby to pills and ensure contrast >=4.5:1 for labels.

ana: Proposal: Tab lands on version node, Enter opens inspector (persistent dialog-like region), arrow keys navigate inside, hover shows transient preview for mouse, no hover on touch.

mike: Copy tweak: change "canary: 5%" -> "Canary 1 5% traffic" (explicit). Add sr-only text for screen readers.

sam: CSS preview example: .rollout-node .preview { transform: translateY(-6px); opacity:0; transition:.12s; } .rollout-node:hover .preview{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);} Use :focus-within to show for keyboard. Add 200ms hide delay to help motor-impaired users.

yvonne: If inspector is role=dialog, don't set aria-modal since it's contextual. Trap focus only if modal; otherwise manage focus return. Ensure rollback confirmation modal has proper labels.

mike: UX decision: show low-prominence inline "Undo" icon that opens a confirmation modal. Avoid destructive single-clicks.

deploy-bot: heads-up: rollout-inspector flag enabled in staging tomorrow 1500UTC.

ana: I'll update Figma and post an engineering checklist: 1) hover preview + 200ms hide, 2) Enter opens persistent inspector, 3) arrow navigation, 4) sr-only pill copy, 5) rollback confirms, 6) microcopy update, 7) contrast/padding fixes.

mike: Sounds good. Close once PR links checklist. :thumbsup:
